_comment: Live trigger eval-set for plan-authoring. Positives = natural-language plan/HOW-only requests with concrete WHAT input; negatives = spec-only, implementation, test, or ambiguous design requests.

queries.query: Onayli export spec'ine gore implementation plan ve task breakdown hazirla; kod yazma.
Turn the acceptance criteria 'user can export CSV and errors are reported' into ordered implementation steps and verification tasks.
WHAT dokumani 'kullanici raporu CSV indirir' icin TDD noktalari, riskler ve sira planini cikar.
Sadece bu feature icin acceptance criteria ve spec yaz.
Bu plani simdi uygula ve feature'i ekle.
